name: Character Game Page
description: RepoChan's mascot character file as a game-style scrollable page: boot sequence, hero cutout, profile with dual-life panels, design index (expressions / states / palette / motifs), pinned day-to-night world, kinetic voice line and fun-facts archive. zh default + en locale, GSAP + ScrollTrigger + Lenis, full prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

assets.description: Full-body character cutout with alpha, centered in the hero; 2:3 portrait works best.

brief.intent: Repaint the full-body hero cutout for the downstream project's own character on a flat matte for chroma-key extraction.
mustInclude: one full-body character, centered, facing the viewer with a confident idle stance
2:3 portrait framing with the full silhouette visible and generous matte margin
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character
creativeFreedom: outfit details from the project foundation

assets.description: Signature scene: after-school afternoon at the Sugar Riff studio. Used in the World pinned day layer, the after-school dual-life panel and as og:image. The lineart reference keeps only the composition (window / desk / chair layout and blank zones) — character identity, text and rendering style are intentionally removed.

brief.intent: Repaint the afternoon studio scene for the downstream project's own character and signature place, keeping the reference lineart's composition exactly.
mustInclude: keep the window / desk / chair layout and the blank zones of the reference composition
warm after-school afternoon light
landscape 3:2, edge-to-edge scene, no text, letters, numbers, watermarks or UI anywhere in the image
avoid: composition drift from the reference lineart
creativeFreedom: studio props that support the project identity
the downstream character's pose and placement

assets.description: Same studio at deadline night; wipes over scene-day in the World section, so the composition must echo scene-day (the night lineart reference was generated against the day lineart).

3×3 web-state sticker sheet sliced into named tiles. The source sheet (kept read-only at repochan/references/webstates-grid.png) was generated with custom cell semantics, so source tiles were mapped to the nearest template key by content (source cell 7 is a maintenance pose published under 'cta'); the page displays tiles positionally without semantic labels. Publications follow the template cell order so a regenerated official/web-state-grid-3x3 sheet extracts correctly. The states grid shows loading / success / not-found / error / searching / cta.

mustInclude: strict 3×3 grid of the project character in the nine fixed web-state poses (template cell semantics)
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character, identical in every pixel outside the stickers
creativeFreedom: pose details inside each fixed semantic

assets.description: 3×3 chibi expression sheet sliced into named tiles. The source sheet (kept read-only at repochan/references/stickers-grid.png) follows official/chibi-grid-3x3 expression semantics; bundles require a cell-keyed template, so publications reuse the official/web-state-grid-3x3 keys with source tiles mapped to the nearest key by content (wave→welcome, curious→searching, celebrating→success, pointing→cta, cozy→cozy; loading/empty/error/not-found hold the remaining expression cells). Cells 2/5/8 are published as background-removed floats (sticker-2/5/8.png) because the hero floats them over the dark scene; the states grid shows searching / not-found / cozy. A regenerated web-state sheet extracts through the same mapping; downstream wanting expression semantics can slice its own chibi sheet to the same outputs.

mustInclude: strict 3×3 grid of the project character in the nine fixed web-state poses (template cell semantics)
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character, identical in every pixel outside the stickers
creativeFreedom: pose details inside each fixed semantic
